model_annotation: The chart is a donut chart, comparing two sets of data represented by the inner and outer rings, displaying the distribution of "Max Ambiguity" and "Ambiguity Std" respectively. The chart has three categories in each ring, totaling six slices. The inner ring, labeled "Max Ambiguity (Inner)", is divided into three slices: "Max: 1" (lightest blue, approximately 49%), "Max: 2" (medium blue, 38%), and "Max: 3" (darkest blue, 14.2%). The outer ring, labeled "Ambiguity Std (Outer)", is also divided into three slices: "Std: 0.47" (dark blue, 47.7%), "Std: 0.82" (medium-dark blue, 39%), and "Std: 0.94" (light blue, 7%). Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The chart includes a legend to the right, which explains the color coding for both the inner and outer rings. The slices are arranged in a clockwise direction, with the largest slice in the inner ring ("Max: 1") and the largest slice in the outer ring ("Std: 0.47") positioned at the top.
